d:
Massive, flowing forest green hair that blends into rocky terrain. Glowing amber eyes with an ancient, stern expression. Appears as an ancient entity of immense maturity. Colossal, mountainous build. Wears organic armor made of living stone and emerald vines in shades of deep olive and slate gray. Features skin composed of tectonic plates and shimmering mineral veins.
BODY COLOR: earthy brown
